title: feat(console): name the records a bulk run wrote, hint which required fields to fill, and show CRM expected revenue as money
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoDdYQJbM1obWY7sMWJcH9sv)_

Part of #27520 (rows 8, 11 and 16; every other row stays on the card)

Clause-②: yes (widening: `ActionResult` gains the optional `fieldErrors` member, `ActionFieldError` is a new export of `@object-ui/types`, and `ActionResponseOutcome` gains `fieldErrors`; no accept set moves)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:批量动作(如 Tasks 的「Mark Done」)结果弹窗不再只写「Succeeded 2 / 2」,而是列出成功的记录名;动作因必填字段被拒(如草稿发票「Submit for Sign-off」缺 Issued On)时,提示变成「Issued On is required. Fill in Issued On, then run “Submit for Sign-off” again.」;CRM 示例的 Expected Revenue 公式声明为货币,与旁边的 Deal Value 同样显示为 `$16,000.00`。
- **为什么改**:18.3.0 RC 走查第 8、11、16 行:用户看不出批量改了哪些记录;被拒后不知道要先去编辑哪个字段;同一表格里两列金额一列带货币一列是普通数字。
- **风险与回滚**:批量名单只在每个失败都对应到具体记录时才显示,服务端只回计数时保持原样;提示只追加在服务端原文之后,只针对 `required` 字段项;`ActionResult` 多一个可选成员(放宽,不收紧)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/consoleServerAction.ts`(`withRequiredFieldsHint`);`ui/packages/core/src/actions/actionResponse.ts`(`refusalFieldErrors`);`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/BulkActionDialog.tsx`(`succeededRows`)。
- **两分钟验证**:showcase 打开一张无 Issued On 的草稿发票点「Submit for Sign-off」,预期红色提示以「Fill in Issued On, then run “Submit for Sign-off” again.」结尾;Tasks → Bulk Actions 视图勾两行点 Mark Done,预期结果弹窗列出两条任务标题。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**Row 8, bulk result names the records.** `BulkActionDialog`'s result step now lists the records the run wrote under the "Succeeded N / M" line, named the way the confirm step names the affected records (`affectedRecordName`, the object's `nameField`), five at most plus "… and N more". The list is drawn only when every failure in the result sits under a record of the run, so the rows left over are exactly the successes. When a bulk call answered a bare count (`executeBulkBatch`'s `batch_<offset>` entry), which records failed is unknown and the result keeps to its count. No server read and no executor change. New key `grid.bulk.succeededRecords` (the list's accessible name) in all ten packs.

**Row 11, a required-field refusal says what to fill in.** The action route answers a refused write with `error.details.fields` (one entry per failed rule, measured live: `{ field: 'issued_on', code: 'required', message: 'Issued On is required', label: 'Issued On' }`). `interpretActionResponse` kept only the text. Now:
- `interpretActionResponse` reads the entries (current envelope `error.details.fields`, legacy inner envelope `fields`), drops entries without a string `field`, and returns them as `fieldErrors`;
- `createServerActionHandler` passes them on the failed `ActionResult` (`fieldErrors?: ActionFieldError[]`, new optional member in `@object-ui/types`);
- the console wrapper `createConsoleServerActionHandler` follows the server's sentence with `console.serverAction.fillRequiredThenRetry` ("Fill in {{fields}}, then run “{{action}}” again.") or, for an action with no label, `fillRequiredFirst`. Only `required` entries on a field count (`_record` and every other code keep the server's text alone). Field names are the server's labels, deduplicated and joined with `validation.formInvalidJoiner`, the key the form's field lists already join with (`Intl.ListFormat` is outside app-shell's lib target, and a `unit` list joins zh with no separator). The server's text stays first and whole; a stop is added only when it has none (a CJK one after CJK text). The wrapper's `t` now takes interpolation values; both call sites (`useConsoleActionRuntime`, `RecordDetailView`) pass them through to i18next as `{ defaultValue, ...values }`.
- An authored `errorMessage` still replaces the whole text in the runner, hint included, as before.

**Row 16, money formula declares money.** `examples/app-crm/src/objects/opportunity.object.ts`: `expected_revenue` declares `returnType: 'currency'`. The renderer reads `returnType` and never infers money from an expression (`FormulaCellRenderer`, objectui#11683 / #11748), so the undeclared formula drew the number face (`16,000`) beside the `Field.currency` Deal Value (`$80,000.00`). The seat lifted the order's no-examples line for exactly this edit (claim amendment 6539593257). No renderer change.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/bulkResultSucceededNames-27520.test.tsx` (3): a clean run lists both titles under the accessible name; a run with one refusal lists only the two that landed and keeps the refused one under its refusal; a `bulkUpdate` answering a bare count names nobody.
- New `ui/packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/actionRefusalFields-27520.test.ts` (5): the measured answer yields `fieldErrors`; an answer that also carries a producer-marked `error.userMessage` keeps them (the hint keys off the entries, never the text, so it survives a `userMessage`); field-less entries are dropped; the legacy inner list is read; the dispatch's failed result carries the entries.
- New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/__tests__/consoleServerAction.requiredFieldsHint-27520.test.ts` (6): the hint after the server's sentence; several fields deduplicated and joined with the pack joiner (zh `、`); a label-less field and a label-less action; `min` and `_record` entries left alone; the host `t` receives the values; the server's own stop kept and a CJK stop added.
- Adapted `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts`: the de census counts the new „{{action}}“ span, with the same one-line history note its earlier rises carry. main's #28310 raised the same pins by one while this was open, so after merging main (6a3bd4e7) they read 103 paired spans and 103 / 103 / 0, both rises noted. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/i18n/` on the merge head: 93 files passed (1433 tests, 13 skipped).
- Ablations (one-time, not kept, at 714e3766, before the `userMessage` case was added), through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty: succeeded list never drawn → 2 failed of 3; count guard removed → 1 failed of 3; core stops returning `fieldErrors` → 8 failed of 10 (core + wrapper files); wrapper returns the refusal unhinted → 5 failed of 6. The suites resolve `@object-ui/*` to source, so no dist leg applies.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/types/ packages/core/ packages/i18n/ packages/plugin-grid/`: at 714e3766: 963 files passed, 1 failed (`de-quote-pairing-3876`, 2 tests: its census counted 101 paired „…“ spans and the new `fillRequiredThenRetry` adds one). The pins were raised to 102 in 9f34e7d3 and the file reran 9/9 passed. The new `userMessage` case in e578f935 ran alone, 5/5 passed.
- app-shell, the wrapper and both call sites: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/utils/__tests__/consoleServerAction packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useConsoleActionRuntime packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView`: 108 files / 761 tests passed (lock VERDICT command-exit 0). The whole `packages/app-shell/` run sat 80 minutes under the lock without finishing on this shared box and was stopped; the rest of app-shell is left to CI.
- `type-check` of `@object-ui/types`, `core`, `i18n`, `plugin-grid`, `app-shell` (full dts closure built first): all Done, 0 `error TS`. `@objectstack/example-crm`: `typecheck` exit 0, `test` 7 files / 48 tests passed, `validate` exit 0 (only the pre-existing `field-no-consumers` warnings on `renewal_of` / `line_total`).

- Dogfood that reads the CRM example's metadata (asked for by the seat for the example edit), against the built `examples/app-crm/dist/objectstack.json` that carries `returnType: 'currency'`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/install-local-purge-sample-data.dogfood.test.ts test/wall-environment-metadata-refusal.dogfood.test.ts test/guest-grants-channel.dogfood.test.ts` → 3 files / 53 tests passed (lock VERDICT command-exit 0). The other dogfood files read only the CRM's flows or views, which this PR leaves alone.

## Acceptance notes

- **Row 8's Status half is the example's own declaration**, not touched: `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/actions/index.ts` `MarkDoneAction` patches `done` and `progress` on purpose, because `status` is governed by `task_status_flow` (only `in_review -> done` is legal), and its doc comment says so.
- **Row 11's "mark fields required for submission" half is not done.** The rule exists (`issued_on` `requiredWhen: record.status in ['sent', 'paid']`), and the edit form evaluates it on the record as it stands, so a draft correctly shows Issued On as optional. Saying "required for Submit for Sign-off" means tying a field's rule to an action's `patch`, which no spec door declares. The seat files that as a spec card.
- The bulk path runs a promoted object action per record through the same wrapper, so a required-field refusal there now reads with the hint under the refused record too.
- The action toast's text comes from `actionErrorDetail`, which reads `error.message` and never `error.userMessage` (a flow-action refusal can carry one). That is unchanged here; the hint rides after whichever text is shown, because it is keyed off `details.fields`. Noted, not filed.
- Row 16 also applies to any author: a money formula with no `returnType` draws a plain number by rule. `os validate` does not warn about it. Noted, not filed.

## Verification

<details><summary>Live before/after (showcase and CRM on --fresh stacks, admin, 1440x900)</summary>

Base `origin/main` b1e1dcf2 (before) and this branch (after), full dts build plus `pnpm console:build`, `LANG=en_US.UTF-8 pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 38611` (showcase) and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-crm dev -- --fresh -p 38612`, driven with Playwright.

- Row 8, Tasks → Bulk Actions view, Content backlog + Evidence collection → Mark Done → Run. Before: dialog text `Mark Done | Succeeded 2 / 2 | Done`. After: `Mark Done | Succeeded 2 / 2 | • Evidence collection | • Content backlog | Done`.
- Row 11, INV-1002 (draft, no Issued On) → Submit for Sign-off. Wire both times: `400 {"success":false,"error":{"code":"VALIDATION_FAILED","message":"Issued On is required","httpStatus":400,"details":{"fields":[{"field":"issued_on","code":"required","message":"Issued On is required","label":"Issued On"}]}}}`. Toast before: `Issued On is required`. After: `Issued On is required. Fill in Issued On, then run “Submit for Sign-off” again.`
- Row 16, CRM → Opportunities, row Initech — Expansion. Before: Deal Value `$80,000.00`, Expected Revenue `16,000`. After: `$80,000.00`, `$16,000.00`.

</details>

At 6a3bd4e7 (this branch merged with main 0f29a88a): `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 54 families against the diff. All 54 ran with `</dev/null`, exit codes recorded (`27520-actions-gates-ran-6a3bd4e7.list` in the seat's out folder). `dispatch-gates --ran`: "54 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 54 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".

- `pnpm check:type-check-debt` first exited 3 (not measured): the closure build could not resolve `@objectstack/observability`, a package main added, because the tree had not been reinstalled after the merge. After `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` it reran: exit 0, "0 raw tsc error(s) total, none above its recorded number". The list records the rerun.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` ran under the verify lock: exit 0.
- Also run: `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations` exit 0; `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exit 0.
- The same 54 families were derived and all exited 0 at 714e3766, before the last test commit and the merge.

</details>
